comments: One bank on the star's centre: one scale for all seven frames (the take flare sets it, so the resting star is about 10 pixels across).
The take frames are imported and approved; the stage has no take effect for a spark (a taken one is simply gone), so it plays the bob frames.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the star's amber: the palette snap sent a few dark orange-brown outline pixels to the signal red (a8341f), single red flecks on the points; the grade maps that one shared ink to the nearest admitted amber-brown (924f1d). No pixel is moved, added or removed.
geometry: Pickup box 10x10 inside the canvas; art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Reading order equals the request order: bob-0..3 (upright, turned right, small, turned left), take-0..2 (flare, ring of shards, fading shards).
